text:
elaine: FYI - admission controller started rejecting canary images this morning with a provenance mismatch. SBOM says layers A,B,C but registry manifest has different layer digests.

raj: oh no. which builder produced those?

elaine: builder-ci-03. suspect change in build cache strategy. paste from admission.log: 

```
AdmissionDenied: provenance-check failed: manifest-layer-digest mismatch for image gcr.io/redwood/runner:2026-03-18-rc3
Expected: sha256:aaa111... Got: sha256:bbb222...
```

sam: did the attestation envelope get uploaded to the artifact bucket? sometimes CI writes attestation to a different path when we switch k8s nodes.

attest-bot: AttestEvent: envelope_upload gcr.io/redwood/runner:2026-03-18-rc3 status=missing location=gs://redwood-artifacts/attestations/2026-03-18

elaine: yep bot shows missing envelope. registry manifest exists but no attestation. admission gate requires cosign envelope + SBOM.

raj: timeline: we rolled a builder image change last night (PR #501) that modified build cache and switched the stash path to /tmp/cache -> caused tar ordering diff. didn't think it would change layer digests but it did.

sam: we need short-term mitigation: (1) relax admission gate for canary group only so canary proceeds, (2) rebuild artifacts with canonical cache settings and sign via KMS, (3) add CI preflight to verify attest upload success before publish.

images-team: we prefer not to relax gate. alternative: force-regenerate attestations from the registry blobs (recompute SBOM+attest) and sign. That avoids changing admission policy.

elaine: can we regenerate attestations without rebuilding? we have the blobs in the registry.

sam: yes, if we can compute SBOM deterministically from the blob and re-run cosign sign with KMS key. but need IAM for attestation service account to read registry blobs and to call KMS signer. any recent RBAC churn?

audit-bot: AuditEvent: IAMPolicyChange actor=infra-bot@redwood time=2026-03-18T09:02:11Z change=removed roles/storage.objectViewer from serviceAccount:attest@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com

raj: that lines up. infra-bot pr accidentally removed the storage viewer role during a bucket policy sync. attestation SA lost read access.

elaine: ok root cause = builder cache change -> layer digest drift; secondary cause = attestation SA lost registry read -> no envelope. Remediation path: restore SA role, regenerate attestations, verify admission checks, then harden CI.

sam: raj can you add storage.objectViewer back and verify with gsutil? exact command: 
```
gsutil ls gs://redwood-artifacts/attestations/2026-03-18 || echo "no artifacts"
```
and gcloud iam policy-binding add: 
```
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood \
  --member=serviceAccount:attest@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/storage.objectViewer
```

raj: running now. i'll paste results.

attest-bot: Action: iam_binding_restored target=project=redwood role=roles/storage.objectViewer member=serviceAccount:attest@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com time=2026-03-18T09:20:03Z

raj: gsutil ls now shows registry blobs and attest bucket entries. good.

elaine: next, images-team - please run the attest regen job against gcr.io/redwood/runner:2026-03-18-rc3. use pipeline job id builders/regenerate-attest/243. signing must use KMS URI: ksm://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prov/cryptoKeys/attestersigner

images-team: queued. regen job done -> attestations created and cosign verify passes locally.

attest-bot: AttestEvent: envelope_upload gcr.io/redwood/runner:2026-03-18-rc3 status=uploaded by=images-ci job=builders/regenerate-attest/243 time=2026-03-18T09:39:20Z

sam: admission re-checks are green for canary. canary rollout continues.

sre-oncall: monitoring traces/latency and canary error rates. no customer-facing anomalies.

elaine: follow-ups for postmortem: (1) add IAM drift detection to infra policy sync (alert when service accounts lose storage access), (2) CI preflight to confirm attestation upload before publishing, (3) revert builder cache change or make tar ordering deterministic, (4) update runbook: if provenance missing -> do not relax admission gate, instead attempt regen and restore SA RBAC.

raj: PRs opened: infra/PR#812 (iam drift alert), builders/PR#502 (canonical cache), ci/PR#190 (preflight attest check).

elaine: thanks everyone. tagging for postmortem notes and owners: @raj (iam), @images-team (regen), @sam (CI). :white_check_mark:
